title: invocation-edge-anchors-and-cost-attribution-scribe
author: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: We have persistent gaps when attributing kernel- and queue-level costs back to the original API invocation. This makes it hard to detect regressions that only appear after retries, fast-fail routing, or multi-stage models. This PR introduces a lightweight 'invocation edge anchor' that tags the first externally-observed span for an invocation and threads that anchor id through downstream kernel and batching spans. The anchor enables deterministic per-invocation cost attribution, improved grouping for long-tail token-cost analysis, and simpler joins between logs, traces, and billing events.

What this changes (summary): 1) New anchor header propagation: runtime sets X-Inv-Anchor on ingress and preserves it across retries and internal requeueing. 2) Tracing integration: span enrichment to include inv_anchor_id and phase labels (parse, kv_cache, decode, send). 3) Metrics rollups: cohort-backed rollups by anchor-phase that power per-invocation token-cost and latency histograms. 4) Dashboard: new invocation-edge Anchors dashboard with sparkline cost-by-phase, cohort breakdown, and a tie-out panel to billing events. 5) Alert tuning: new adaptive alert rules that use anchor-cohorts to suppress noisy token-cost alerts from known heavy prompt cohorts. 6) E2E tests and a small util for reconciling anchor -> billing join keys.

Why this PR is different: rather than changing sampling rates or adding more aggregation jobs, the anchor provides a single join key that dramatically reduces downstream cardinality when doing per-invocation joins. This accelerates our ability to run deterministic regressions on token cost and latency across retries and fallbacks.

Checklist: [x] Propagate anchor header in runtime ingress [x] Add anchor to spans at kernel/batcher layers [x] Emit per-anchor phase counters and histograms [x] Dashboard JSON and panels added [x] Unit + integration tests for anchor propagation [x] Rollout plan in PR description (staged: beta tenants -> 10% roll -> 100%)

Rollout plan (short): stage to stable-tenants (opt-in) for 48h to validate billing joins and traffic behavior; enable at 10% across regions for 24h; full release if no cost regressions or token-attribution mismatches.

References: Linear ENG-1982 (anchor design), ENG-2037 (dashboard panels), Jira INT-3241 (support case where tenant billing mismatch observed).

b8f1d22: tracing: annotate kernel and batcher spans with inv_anchor_id and phase
c9d2ea0: telemetry: cohort rollup job and aggregation helpers
f5e3b71: dashboards: add invocation-edge-anchors.json and dashboard panels
d12a6c4: tests: e2e anchor propagation + billing join util
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Nice approach — I like a single join key. Question: what happens to anchors for streamed, chunked responses?
Asha Menon (author): For streaming we set the anchor on the first request frame and include it in the chunk metadata header. Kernel/batcher code reads and ignores if absent (backcompat).
Priya Shah: Need to ensure the anchor doesn't inflate cardinality when callers mutate prompts per-retry. Suggest adding a bounded LRU for anchor->prompt hashes in rollup job.
Asha Menon (author): Added an LRU-backed deduper in telemetry/rollups to limit cardinality — see anchor_cohorts_job.yaml and commit c9d2ea0.
Liam O'Connor: CI flakes on telemetry e2e, please make tests idempotent and add a retry wrapper.
Asha Menon (author): Added retry wrapper and expanded test timeouts; reran CI.
release_notes: Add invocation-edge anchors to enable deterministic per-invocation cost and latency attribution, new dashboard panels for anchor-phase rollups, and alert tuning to reduce churn from heavy prompt cohorts.
notes_for_ops: Enable rollout by feature-flag: observability.inv_anchor.enable. Monitor billing join error rate and anchor propagation failure metric (telemetry.anchor.propagation.failures) during rollout.
post_merge_tasks: 1) Backpopulate anchor ids for 24h of recent traces for customers who opt-in to historical joins (job scheduled), 2) Add runbook entry for anchor propagation mismatch (docs/observability/runbooks/anchor_mismatch.md).
security_considerations: Anchor id is a random 128-bit value, no PII. We avoid embedding prompt text in anchor metadata; only a stable hash is used for deduping in rollups.
manual_test_steps: 1) Start a local runtime with feature flag enabled, 2) Send a request that triggers a retry and verify X-Inv-Anchor header across retries, 3) Check traces in APM for inv_anchor_id on kernel spans, 4) Verify dashboard shows a sample anchor cohort and costs map back to billing events.
changelog_entry: observability: add invocation edge anchors and anchor-phase rollups (ENG-1982)
estimated_impact: small runtime overhead (~0.1% added header processing), significant reduction in join-time complexity for billing+trace correlation
author_notes: Follow-up PR will add an opt-out sampling mode and a compact anchor alias to reduce label cardinality further.
